# Hormozi Advisor Skill

Canonical entry point: skills/hormozi/SKILL.md
Agent metadata: skills/hormozi/agents/openai.yaml
Business profile template: skills/hormozi/assets/business-profile-template.md
Architecture: docs/architecture.md
Install and migration: docs/install.md
Source policy: docs/source-policy.md
YouTube sync contract: docs/youtube-sync.md

Operating references:
- skills/hormozi/references/advisor-workflow.md
- skills/hormozi/references/business-context.md
- skills/hormozi/references/onboarding.md
- skills/hormozi/references/answer-contract.md
- skills/hormozi/references/communication-standard.md
- skills/hormozi/references/source-policy.md
- skills/hormozi/references/mode-index.md

Public doctrine:
- skills/hormozi/references/doctrine/index.md
- skills/hormozi/references/doctrine/rule-index.json

Deterministic helpers:
- skills/hormozi/scripts/business_context.py
- skills/hormozi/scripts/authority_packet.py
- skills/hormozi/scripts/route.py
- skills/hormozi/scripts/corpus.py
- skills/hormozi/scripts/economics.py
- skills/hormozi/scripts/plain_language.py
- skills/hormozi/scripts/validate_doctrine.py

Core commands:
- Resolve business context: python3 skills/hormozi/scripts/business_context.py resolve --start /path/to/business
- Import licensed text equivalents: python3 skills/hormozi/scripts/corpus.py import --source-root /path/to/source-root --manifest /path/to/source-manifest.jsonl --index skills/hormozi/private-corpus/index/hormozi.sqlite
- Retrieve bounded file doctrine: python3 skills/hormozi/scripts/corpus.py query --corpus-root skills/hormozi/private-corpus --query "decision terms" --source-type file --limit 6
- Retrieve reviewed recent-video evidence: python3 skills/hormozi/scripts/corpus.py query --corpus-root skills/hormozi/private-corpus --query "decision terms" --source-type youtube --limit 6
- Check each user-facing draft: python3 skills/hormozi/scripts/plain_language.py --file /path/to/draft.md --target-grade 3 --strict

YouTube sync ownership:
- The package defines the source contract in docs/youtube-sync.md.
- Each install owns its credentials and configured runner.
- Synced YouTube records enter the bundled corpus and are queried through corpus.py.

Important boundaries:
- This package does not impersonate Alex Hormozi or imply endorsement.
- Personalized advice requires an approved BUSINESS.md.
- The full source library ships in `skills/hormozi/private-corpus/`.
- Recent video material changes doctrine only after manual timestamp, speaker, context, and visual review.
